name: alert
title: Alert
description: A message that stays on screen, with a title and a tone.
a11y: danger and warning are role=alert and announced at once; info and success are role=status and polite.
The title always states the meaning in words; colour is not the only signal.

props.name: tone
props.description: Meaning of the message: `info` (default), `success`, `warning` or `danger`. `warning` and `danger` are announced at once to screen readers.

props.name: title
props.description: The headline of the message. Required: the words carry the meaning, the colour is only extra.

props.name: children
props.description: Optional longer explanation shown under the title.

usage:
import {Alert} from '@monoline/react';
